label: Vocabulary-independent physical-ground declaration blocked by specification semantics
summary: Owner approved preserving both naming and definability siblings. Implemented Mathlib first-order syntax and full-domain denotation, ordinary-symbol sublanguage restriction and permitted-parameter subtypes. Local definite description forbids all parameters and has no admitted individual constants. Uniform definability checks a single formula over a nonempty supplied class. Bool marker-inversion proves a local description need not uniformly define the fixed singleton across the class; it does not equate different ontological targets. Permitted-parameter success and emptiness of the forbidden-parameter syntax subtype are separate. A separately empty composition assignment coexists with local naming; no existing ground model is calibrated. Rejected shortcuts from the prior audit remain rejected: flags, composite definitions, opaque aliases, arbitrary names and finite toy physics. Reused the same Mathlib semantics as TruthCore.Logic.ReferenceAnchor and its interpretation-transport method. Definitions and siblings persist in DISAMB-PHYSICAL-GROUND and specs/physical-ground-specification.toml. No source claims or old bindings changed.
blocker: Original PHYSICAL_OF_A_GROUND_2 remains unresolved: choose/defend adequacy of name-free definite descriptions for the intended naming interpretation; calibrate ordinary predicates to exclude disguised names and special vocabulary; fix the actual language, interpretation class, cross-interpretation target identity and permitted parameters; decide whether varying-carrier semantics is required; and specify occurrence/property-to-ground-bearer passage without composition. New siblings are not exhaustive-original coverage. simpleImpersonal remains untested. Next root connection is a calibrated interpretation of the same ground at STMT-COMPOSITE-HAS-A-UNITING-CAUSE / STMT-IMMATERIAL-IS-INTELLECTUAL, retaining PhysicalBearersComposite only as an explicit independent bridge.
